input.prompt: Speak as a warm, conversational Turkish narrator addressing one curious listener. Sound like a thoughtful person sharing a discovery as it becomes clear, with natural human cadence, varied sentence energy, and quiet curiosity. Let short reveal sentences land, then slow slightly for explanation. Use clear Istanbul Turkish diction and natural pauses. Avoid sermon, classroom lecture, documentary-announcer delivery, exaggerated drama, and a repeated rhetorical rise-and-fall. Do not give every section the same cadence. Pronounce Arabic Quranic words naturally as Arabic, then return smoothly to Turkish.
input.text: O nesne ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ (zekati)dir. Belirlilik eki ve nesne konumu, konuyu belirsiz comertlikten taninan bir hakka ceker: aktarilmasi gereken sey "zekat"tir. Kelimenin bagli oldugu alan buyume, artma, arinma ve duzelme baskisini da tasir; bu yuzden ayette kesilen transfer, mal cikisiyla birlikte buyumeyi dolasima sokan ve vereni de aritan bir islem olarak kalinlasir. Ses de ayni baskiyi tasir: belirli artikel z sesine katilir, cift z harfi kelimeyi sikistirir, uzun acilis sonra gelir. Zekatin taninan hak olusu ile buyume-arinma alani ayni yerde durur; verilmeyen sey hem toplumsal pay hem de aritici artis imkani olur.
